hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 custom swap curve between ETH (currency0) and phiEth (currency1), bypassing the concentrated liquidity mechanism entirely. Liquidity additions are blocked; swaps are executed by taking tokens from the pool manager, depositing or withdrawing via the phiEth contract, and settling back at a fixed 1:1 rate with zero fees.
